shortDescription: Offshore investors sold a net 3.89 billion rand ($241.31 million) worth of South African stocks last week, Johannesburg Stock Exchange data showed on Monday.Net sales of bonds totalled 3.03 billion rand, settlement data showed.($1 = 16.1206 rand)
